mainEntity.name: Is JAN-PRO a franchise, and who actually cleans my office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. JAN-PRO Canada describes a three-tier franchise: JAN-PRO Canada franchises regional offices, which in turn franchise local Certified Business Owners (unit franchisees). JAN-PRO states that CBOs and their own staff perform the work and that there is no subcontracting, and every jan-pro.ca page notes that services are provided by independently owned and operated JAN-PRO unit franchisees (read 2026-10-28).

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a franchise cleaning company and a local cleaning company?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a franchise, a brand licenses its systems, training and guarantee to independent operators who do the cleaning and hold their own insurance and WSIB coverage. In a local company, one business employs the crew, holds the WSIB account and insurance, and its owner is the final decision-maker. Neither structure is automatically better; it decides who you call and whose paperwork you should check.

mainEntity.name: Does it matter whether my cleaners are employees or franchisees?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the quality of the floor, not necessarily. For your risk, yes: ask whose WSIB clearance certificate and whose certificate of insurance cover the people who enter your building, and obtain both in the name of that entity.

mainEntity.name: How much does office cleaning cost in Toronto?

acceptedAnswer.text: No commercial cleaner publishes a Toronto rate card. JAN-PRO Canada publishes a national starting point of $250 a month (as of 2026-10-28); Evergreen quotes after a free on-site walkthrough. Price moves with square footage and layout, cleaning frequency, scope, facility type, service hours and who supplies consumables, so compare quotes on identical scope and frequency.

mainEntity.name: What should I ask for before signing a commercial cleaning contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: A written task-and-frequency scope, a current WSIB clearance certificate, a certificate of insurance naming your organisation, the name and role of your day-to-day contact, the plan for covering absences, the guarantee in writing, safety data sheets for the products used, and the notice period and price-change terms.

mainEntity.name: Can a one-office local company cover several GTA sites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Evergreen dispatches crews from one Toronto office across Toronto, Peel, Halton, York Region and Durham. A franchise network such as JAN-PRO offers a national accounts programme with centralized billing across provinces. Match the vendor to your footprint: a handful of GTA sites suits a local company; a multi-province estate suits a network.

mainEntity.name: Do franchise cleaners offer a guarantee, and what is Evergreen's?

acceptedAnswer.text: JAN-PRO Canada publishes a 100% satisfaction guarantee: regularly scheduled services completed on time, service issues resolved within one business day, and a complimentary cleaning if either promise is missed (read 2026-10-28). Evergreen's commitment is a written scope, scheduled inspections and a dedicated account executive. REPLACE_EVERGREEN_GUARANTEE_TEXT
